QUESTION:
What is the recommended starting dose of Levothyroxine Sodium?

RESPONSE:
For adults with hypothyroidism the usual full replacement starting dose is 1.6 mcg/kg/day. Patients at risk for atrial fibrillation, with underlying cardiac disease, or geriatric patients should start at a lower dose (<1.6 mcg/kg/day) and be titrated more slowly. Pediatric starting doses (by age, mcg/kg/day): 0–3 months: 10–15; 3–6 months: 8–10; 6–12 months: 6–8; 1–5 years: 5–6; 6–12 years: 4–5; >12 years with incomplete growth/puberty: 2–3; growth/puberty complete: 1.6. (Titrate per label every 2–6 weeks as appropriate.)
